So no row verdict changes; the defect is a completeness claim in an evidence paragraph whose completeness is checkable and false, repeated in the body of commit bef439dbd.

The inventory table runs 1..18 then inserts 25 before resuming 19..24 (:58-59), with no cue in the table that the pairing is deliberate; the explanation appears only in the prose section 'Rows 18 and 25' at :154.
